svg.title: Turn 1 · explain without a tool
svg.desc: Turn 1 · explain without a tool. Run 1 ends; the calculator stays available. Same Session across both turns. maximum_planned_loss remains available. user · conceptual question: What is stop-loss referring to; in day trading?. assistant · example explanation: A stop-loss is an exit plan intended; to limit loss; the fill is not guaranteed.. Inference reconstructs the answer. Effects propose saving the answer. Effect handler applies them to the store. Reload: no request; no reply needed. No work → return to the application. Events support presentation; Effects and the effect handler save recorded state. Narrated example, not guaranteed model behavior.
